axis_map._conclusion: Hinge axis is per-GROUP (uniform within group), not per-record: local X for limb/torso/pelvis groups (BD, 6198, 613B, 64DB300F, 7CC9B660, 099CD766, 347D3654, 095CD669, 637B7003/F3); local Z for head (5B214D41/4E) and accessory chains (7AD45E02, 6865B2C0/CF, 64D45E02); local Y for 60F8F527/D7.

chain.conclusion: 2ch->3rec ASSIGNMENT RESOLVED: ch1->rec1 (proximal: hip/shoulder), ch2->rec2 (middle: knee/elbow); rec3 (ankle/wrist) has NO channel - fixed at bind. Evidence: ch2 range to 146.3deg over 331 leg tracks (median 55.3) = knee-scale motion, anatomically impossible for an ankle (ROM ~+-35deg); arm ch2 to 82.8deg = elbow-scale. ch1 always spans ~+-80deg (bind->stand snap + locomotion). No track carries a third channel for any chain group (21 tracks = 21 groups, 1:1); downstream FK should hold rec3 at bind or solve procedurally.

dualA.conclusion: dual-A = bilateral COMMON-MODE hinge angle (same asin s16/32767 encoding as B, same primary hinge axis as the group). Per-record total: rec_i(t) = A(t) + B_i(t). B = per-side differential trims. Evidence: (1) A angle-scale (asin range up to +-80deg, same as primary hinges); translation ruled out. (2) dt-sum(A)~=dt-sum(B) on 310 tracks (same clip span). (3) r2(A~B1,B2)~=0 everywhere: A is an independent component, not derived from B. (4) Symmetric clips (a.yag 64DB300F): A=+-80deg pulses dominate, B tiny, totals T1,T2 corr +0.86 (bilateral symmetric). Asymmetric clips (a000_0a): A small, B large (B1 -0.7..77.5, B2 -64.9..0.9), T corr +0.16. (5) max|A+B_i|<=92.3deg over all tracks: totals respect joint ROM, consistent with same-axis addition. (6) Dual tracks exist only for 2-record groups with symmetric motion (64DB300F, 7CC9B660, 0C5BF279); other 2-record groups (347D3654, 613B7547/B7) use single tracks (ch1->rec1, ch2->rec2). Key format CORRECTED: (s16 value, u8 flags, u8 dt), 8B header (doc said (s16,s16) dt; the middle bytes are flags+u8 dt). flags byte: 0 on hold keys, varying on angle keys; semantics open. 8B header: magic C13FC13F in some files, per-track/per-file otherwise; semantics open. f32 triple in directory record ~(-0.0024,0,0.0002) for dual (vs exactly (0,0,0) for single); semantics open.
